description: Dated facts to read before you pay or rely on an agent, a wallet or an endpoint: when Nooscape first saw each listing, its recorded ownership changes, the share of its ratings that were revoked, how many listings its wallet registered, and the evidence level. Give exactly one of agent, wallet or url. Facts only: there is no score and no verdict. Needs a Pro key or an x402 payment (currently $0.01 per call); this server does not pay, so without a Pro key it explains what is needed.

agent.description: One agent, by chain and id.

chain.description: The chain: robinhood, bnb, solana, ethereum, base or arc.

id.description: The agent's id on its registry: the token id (digits) on robinhood, bnb, ethereum, base and arc, the address on solana.

registry.description: Solana only, when more than one registry lists the address (the answer then names them).

chain.description: Narrows a wallet or a url to one chain. Do not give it with agent.

url.description: An endpoint address or a bare host (example.com): the listings that name that host. Nothing is fetched from it.

wallet.description: A wallet address (0x... or a Solana address): the listings it registered.

name: check
title: Pre-flight check
